request.tip1Body: State deliverables, timeline, and success criteria so responders know if they fit.
request.tip2Body: A budget range helps the matcher surface relevant professionals faster.
request.tip3Body: Category and tags drive discovery in browse and AI matching.
request.visibilityBody: Requests are visible to subscribers browsing opportunities unless marked confidential.

offer.tip1Body: Official offers must be tied to an organization profile you manage.
offer.tip2Body: Transparent compensation ranges improve match quality and applicant trust.
offer.tip3Body: Set a deadline so listings auto-expire and stay fresh in search.

cv.tip1Body: Rate Ring Platform, React 19, and Next.js skills — these power matcher ranking.
cv.tip2Body: GitHub and live project URLs matter more than generic summaries.
cv.tip3Body: State when you can start; urgent projects filter on availability.

ring.tip1Body: List modules, integrations, or white-label surfaces you need customized.
ring.tip2Body: Note cloud vs self-hosted, locales, and expected traffic tier.
ring.tip3Body: Ring projects vary widely — a range helps partners respond accurately.

picker.tip1Body: Requests seek help; offers post roles; CV shares your profile; Ring type scopes platform work.
picker.tip2Body: Offers and Ring customization require Member privileges or higher.
